svg.title: textPath path data with a command missing its coordinates is used up to that command

html:meta.content: The error here is a lineto whose coordinate pair never arrives, not an unrecognised token. A parser can reject a stray word at the lexer and still mishandle a command that runs out of numbers, so the two shapes of error are tested separately. Everything before the error is kept.
html:meta.name: assert
